votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of August 17, 2021; June 7, 2022; August 16, 2022; October 4, 2022, as well as the formal meeting minutes of November 22, 2022, and December 6, 2022.
votes.description: The Council approved several past work session and formal meeting minutes spanning from August 2021 through December 2022.

votes.motion: Nominate Darin Mano as Chair and Victoria Petro as Vice Chair for the Calendar Year 2023.
votes.description: The Council ratified the election of Darin Mano as Council Chair and Victoria Petro as Vice Chair for the 2023 calendar year.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 01 of 2023 amending the City Code pertaining to meetings of the Salt Lake City Council.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending City Code 2.06.030 to govern the calculation of a quorum during hybrid/electronic meetings when one or more Council members participate remotely.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda with the exception of items 6 and 7.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items, which included setting a public hearing date for an EV readiness ordinance and approving multiple board appointments and reappointments, excluding items 6 (Olivia Joylani Kavapalu) and 7 (Uliva Guadarrama) from the Racial Equity in Policing Commission.
